extraction_notes: FY24 10-K is light on J-Book-grounded specifics: no PE numbers, no named DoD programs (no Maven/EOCL/Hybrid Architecture/SDA/etc.). Defense & Intelligence is named as one of multiple customer verticals. Planet Labs Federal Inc. exists as the cleared subsidiary. Customer concentration claim (21% from one unnamed customer) is the most material disclosure but the customer is not named, so it cannot be pin-tied to a specific PE. Claims below extract the closest available DoD/government-program language plus 3 control claims (patent / facility / counterparty).

claims.claim_text: One customer accounted for 21% of revenue for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024 (FY24), up from 19% (FY23) and 18% (FY22) — material single-customer concentration without naming the customer or the underlying contract/program.
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.source_quote: For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024, one customer accounted for 21% of revenue.

queries.rationale: Identify any DoD-side concentration that could support the 21% single-customer disclosure
Get total federal obligation footprint and top awarding agencies
Search J-Book corpus for any PE on which Planet is a primary contractor
Same lookup against the federal subsidiary name

claims.source_quote: Governments are strategically engaging with commercial space and remote sensing companies to leverage sharable, unclassified subscription products to complement more traditional defense and security industrial solutions. ... we believe geo-mapping foundation data, maritime domain awareness, humanitarian and disaster recovery, and natural resource monitoring are examples of the many potential drivers of this opportunity.
